app.name: kilna
app.tagline: From raw idea to shipped work.

status.noProfile: This workspace has no active profile.

empty.title: Nothing selected
empty.body: Pick a work on the left, or add one.
empty.worksBody: A work is one song, chapter or episode — whatever your profile calls it.
empty.worksFilteredBody: Clear the search or the filters to see everything again.
empty.catalogueBody: Score a work and it appears here, ranked.
empty.trashBody: Anything you delete waits here until you empty it.
empty.journalBody: Add a work, score one, plan a release - it all gets written down here.
empty.journalClearBody: Warnings show up here. There are none right now.
empty.historyBody: What you do to this work will be listed here.

work.title: Title
work.statusPinned: Set by hand — the automation leaves it alone.
work.unpinStatusHint: Hand the status back to the automation and work it out now.
work.tagPlaceholder: A word for what this is
work.star: Star it: come back to this one
work.copyLink: Copy a link to this card

versions.title: Versions
versions.actionsOn: On {{name}} — what comes back is about this revision.
versions.none: No versions in this role yet.
versions.draftPlaceholder: Paste or write a new draft — it is kept whole, not as a diff
versions.newHint: Write a version from nothing, or give one a name
versions.edit: Edit — the first change starts the next revision, and every change after saves into it
versions.expand: Give the text the whole screen
versions.diffFirst: This is the first revision of this role — there is nothing before it to compare with.
versions.deriveFrom: Start a new version from this one

styleguide.title: Styleguide
styleguide.rule: The living inventory of the design system. Screens take their primitives from here — a control that is not on this page does not go on any other.
styleguide.sampleBody: Body text carries the reading weight of every screen.
styleguide.hint: A hint sits under the control.
styleguide.iconsNote: Icons come from lucide — never from text glyphs.

data.statusHint: Statuses follow what has happened — a score, a slot, a release. This shows where the words have fallen behind the facts, without changing anything. Works whose status you set by hand are left out.
data.exportHint: Every work as markdown — front matter, full bodies, scores, releases and notes. Readable without kilna.
data.backupHint: The whole workspace in one file, taken safely while the app is running.
data.restoreHint: To restore, close kilna and put the backup in place of that file.
data.mcpHint: kilna --mcp serves this workspace to an agent such as Claude Code over the Model Context Protocol: it can read your works, versions, scores and calendar, and propose a version, a score or a note — which you apply here, or don't. Register it with this command:
data.mcpAfter: Proposals land in a chat named after the agent — on the work, or on nothing for a work it proposes — and the bell counts them.
data.importHint: Bring in works, drafts and scores from an earlier system. Titles already here are left alone, and so are titles you deleted here.
data.imported: Imported {{works}} works, {{versions}} drafts, {{scores}} scores. Skipped {{skipped}} already here.
data.importedLeftDeleted_one: Left {{count}} you had deleted where it was.
data.importedLeftDeleted_other: Left {{count}} you had deleted where they were.

dashboard.quietBody: Everything is scored, booked or already out. Write something new, or take the evening.

findings.title: Worth doing
findings.askHint: Asks the assistant. The answer lands in a chat; you decide what to do with it.

kind.stale-score: “{{title}}” was edited after it was scored
kind.ready-unscheduled: “{{title}}” is judged but nothing is booked
kind.weak-scheduled: “{{title}}” holds a slot while stronger work waits
kind.stale-draft: “{{title}}” has not moved in a while

findings.dismissHint: Puts this complaint away. It comes back if it changes.

focus.addPlaceholder: Something to keep in front of you

calendar.dropToUnschedule: Drop here to return it to the queue
calendar.pinSlotHint: The auto-layout will not put anything here.
calendar.widen: Give the month the full width
calendar.clearDateHint: Clearing the date returns it to the queue.
calendar.layoutNeedsRhythm: Set a release rhythm in the profile first.
calendar.layoutPreview_one: {{count}} release would land between {{from}} and {{to}}. Nothing is booked yet.
calendar.layoutPreview_other: {{count}} releases would land between {{from}} and {{to}}. Nothing is booked yet.
calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.queueHint: Strongest first. Pick one, then give it a date.
calendar.queueEmpty: Nothing waiting. Add a release from a work.
calendar.unscored: Not scored yet, so it sorts last in the queue.

preview.pinned: {{title}} is here, and the date is kept

releases.title: Releases
releases.wentOutOnHint: The day it shipped, if that is not today.
releases.linkLooksWrong: That is not a web address, so it will not open.

score.title: Score
score.mirroring: These are the marks of the recorded score. Move one to judge again.
score.noAxes: This kind of work has no axes yet, so there is nothing to judge it on.
score.noAxesLink: Write its axes in the profile.
score.partial: {{filled}} of {{count}} axes filled — the unfilled ones are skipped, not counted as zero.
score.pinTierTitle: Hold this work at a tier
score.pinTierWhy: The score keeps being recorded; the tier stops following it until you let it go.
score.followFactsHint: Let the score decide the tier again
score.byKind: What each release makes of it
score.byKindReweighed: This kind weighs the axes its own way
score.byKindSame: This kind weighs the axes the way the profile does
score.raterHint: Leave empty when it is you
score.blindOnHint: Hide the past verdict and the assistant's until you have given yours
score.blindHidden: The past verdict is hidden while you judge.

catalogue.staleHint: The work was edited after this score was taken.
catalogue.starredHint: Only the works you starred to come back to
catalogue.queryHint: Narrow with status:, kind:, tier:, tag: — or type words to search titles. Quote a phrase: "paper boats".
catalogue.viewSaveHint: Keep the current filter, sort and grouping under a name.

gapHint.unscheduled: Judged, but nothing has gone out and nothing is booked.
gapHint.stale: The work changed after it was scored.

assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.unavailable: Claude Code is not available on this machine.
assistant.placeholder: Ask about this work — Enter sends, Shift+Enter for a new line, / for actions
assistant.placeholderAnywhere: Ask anything — Enter sends, Shift+Enter for a new line
assistant.deleteBody: The whole conversation goes with it — questions, answers and runs. This cannot be undone.
assistant.insertBody: The answer becomes a version of this work, exactly as written.
assistant.openBusy: Open the assistant — runs are going
assistant.noChats: Ask from a work's card, or start one here about anything.
assistant.batchQueued: {{started}} started, {{queued}} waiting for a free slot.
assistant.batchNothing: Nothing to send — those are already running.
assistant.taskEnded: The assistant stopped without an answer.
assistant.waitingTitle: The assistant is waiting on you in
assistant.proposedPackage: A package for this work, proposed
assistant.packageUnknownFields: Not fields of this profile, left out: {{fields}}
assistant.proposedScenesReplace: A storyboard to replace the board, proposed
assistant.scenesReplaceHint: A scene with the same number is rewritten in place; the rest of the board goes to the trash.
assistant.proposedScenesRevise: A revision of scenes on the board, proposed
assistant.proposalRefused: Nothing to apply — the answer’s block could not be read as a proposal: {{why}}
assistant.previewHint: Exactly what the run receives: the message with the work filled in, and the method it is briefed with.
assistant.attachmentsHint: Paths, one per line. The run is told to read them before answering and may read their folders.

links.noSources: Made from nothing in particular. Name a source below, or leave it.
links.noDerived: Nothing has been made from this yet.
links.pickPlaceholder: Name a source — start typing a title
links.driftedInPlace: changed since — the same revision, edited

scenes.noContext: Nothing shared yet — the hero, the palette, the lens. Every scene reads it.
scenes.empty: No scenes yet. Add the first below.
scenes.emptyWithActions: No scenes yet. Write the plot and the context, then let an action above draw the board — or add the first scene below.
scenes.actionsHint: On the board: what comes back is a proposal, applied with one button.
scenes.noneOfShot: No scenes of that kind of shot.
scenes.noneForKind: Works of this kind have no storyboard. Give the kind kinds of shot or prompt blocks in the profile to open one.
scenes.aboutHint: Who is in it, where it happens:
scenes.readinessHintShot: A scene is shot when it is filled in and one of its frames is chosen.
scenes.framesHint: The pictures drawn for this scene. Choose the one the video is cut from.
scenes.addFrameHint: Pick a file, drop one here, or paste an image with Ctrl+V.
scenes.frameNotAnImage: That is not a picture — frames are PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF or AVIF.
scenes.readinessHint: A scene is filled in when it has a description and every prompt block.
scenes.readinessHintNoBlocks: This kind names no prompt blocks, so a described scene is filled in.
scenes.frameHint: One scene per part the text marks out — [Verse 1], [Chorus] — in its own order.
scenes.timeHint: Divide the work's duration between the scenes, evenly — drag from there.
scenes.badTime: “{{text}}” is not a time — type it as 1:23 or 0:04.5.
scenes.unlistedBlock: A block the profile no longer names — kept, not edited here.

video.addFrameHint: Pick a file or drop one here.

montage.copied: The montage list is on the clipboard.

clone.hint: A new video from the same donor, with this board copied into it. This one is left as it is.
clone.title: Name the second attempt

files.copiedIn: A file is copied into the workspace, so a backup carries it.
files.empty: No files yet. A cover shows on the card, in the catalogue and in the calendar.

editor.axesHint: Label and weight. Keys are fixed — past scores are stored under them, and renaming one would orphan its history.
editor.tiersHint: What a score licenses you to do, and the total it takes to get there.
editor.rhythmHint: How often releases go out. The auto-layout keeps this many days between them; leave it empty for no set pace.
editor.keysHint: Existing works keep the status and kind they already had, even if you edit the wording here.
editor.promptsHint: Each action is a short message with placeholders, a method the assistant is briefed with, and what the answer becomes. Keys are fixed once made.
editor.actionTemplateHint: Sent as the message, with {title}, {body}, {role:lyrics}, {scenes}, {scene} and {donor:lyrics} filled from the work. Keep it short; the method carries the how. A placeholder nothing fills is refused at save.
editor.actionMethodHint: How the action is done: the role the assistant takes, what it checks and in what order, the shape of the answer, what it must never say. Markdown; goes to the model as a system instruction.
editor.actionMethodPlaceholder:
# Role

# What to check

# Output

# Never write
editor.actionKeyTaken: An action with this key already exists.

error.database: The workspace database refused that. Nothing was changed.
error.io: Could not reach the workspace on disk.
error.schemaTooNew: This workspace was written by a newer version of kilna. Update the app to open it.
error.notFound: That is not here any more — it was probably deleted in another view.
error.assistant: The assistant could not be reached. Check that Claude Code is installed and on your PATH.
error.notRestorable: The work this belonged to is in the trash too. Restore that first.
error.layoutStale: The calendar changed since this preview was drawn. Lay the queue out again.

crash.title: This screen stopped working
crash.body: The rest of the app is fine. Try again — if it keeps happening, the detail below is worth reporting.

toast.slotPinned: The layout will leave that date alone.
toast.slotUnpinned: The layout may use that date again.
toast.layoutFailed: Could not lay the queue out
toast.versionDerived: The text is in the editor. Saving makes it the next revision.
toast.tierUnpinned: The score has its say again

trash.title: Trash
trash.hint: Nothing leaves for good until you say so.
trash.emptyBody_one: {{count}} entry will be deleted for good. This cannot be undone.
trash.emptyBody_other: {{count}} entries will be deleted for good. This cannot be undone.

journal.title: History
journal.work.cloned: “{{title}}” started as a second attempt, with {{scenes}} scenes copied.
journal.tier.unpinned: “{{title}}” is judged by its score again.
journal.status.resynced_one: {{count}} work restated to match the facts.
journal.status.resynced_other: {{count}} works restated to match the facts.
journal.scene.timed: The board of “{{title}}” timed across {{count}} scenes.
journal.scene.framed: The board of “{{title}}” framed into {{count}} scenes.
journal.release.notReady: “{{title}}” goes out on {{date}} but is not ready.
journal.release.unreleased: “{{title}}” is no longer out as a {{kind}}.

search.title: Search
search.hint: Titles, drafts, notes and what the assistant said.

keys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
keys.description: What the application answers to, wherever you are in it.
keys.typing: Letter shortcuts stand aside while you are typing; the ones with a modifier keep working — except Ctrl+Z, which belongs to the field you are in.

undo.work.pinTier: holding a work at a tier
undo.scene.attachNote: saying what a scene is about
undo.scene.detachNote: taking that out of a scene
